title: More ways to make images
summary:
Six community projects joined the lists, from image-making tools and a Flutter SDK to a podcast where the models do the talking.

The creative-app showcase added Ayushman Bhattacharya’s Elixpo Art, which supports aspect ratios and reference images, and LAHGen, a text-to-image app with multiple artistic styles.

The project lists added mahmood-asadi’s WordPress AI Vision Block, which saves generated images to the Media Library with a post, and @Meenapintu’s Flutter/Dart SDK for text, image and audio generation.

The directory added @the_yerminator’s AlphaLLM Discord bot for conversation-aware text, images and voice, alongside @brain.diver’s Podcast #1500, where LLMs discuss topics including vibe coding. Project-submission instructions also gained an attribution requirement.
